The resource fixtures also mask those paths and have split enumeration ownership, so all five findings must be corrected and independently re-audited before parser work continues.

boundary.startingEvent: A valid ASCII POSIX ERE installed by startup MSGTYPE or AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION is matched through the recorder-glibc REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB contract.
boundary.endingEvent: Matching selects the same boolean and MSGTYPE action as recorder glibc within the committed direct and reference time/memory budgets at exact 255-byte pattern and message limits.
boundary.validInputs: Finite repeated groups with referenced descendants, suffix-reaching correlated and zero-minimum reference patterns, and unanchored direct/reference wide-frontier patterns within the source byte limits.
boundary.observables: Match boolean and installed MSGTYPE action, complete fresh screens/cursors and PRNG calls, plus isolated wall time and maxRSS for every declared exact-boundary resource case.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing/serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and behavior after the next message/input boundary remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: sys/share/posixregex.c regex_match delegates to glibc regexec; glibc capture endpoint selection defines the finite-repeat result; options.c msgtype_type and add_autopickup_exception are the installed consumers.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The shared exact-boundary fixture catalog, its complete budget map, 255-byte source limits, repeat endpoint states, referenced capture ids, candidate starts, and absolute suffix constraints define the audited families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: The audit supplied direct-libc/live MSGTYPE discriminators for the endpoint defect and four suffix-reaching exact-boundary families that separately exercise correlated state, zero-minimum state, direct candidate ordering, and reference candidate reuse.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Inspect js/posixregex.js repeat endpoint/continuation projections, direct/reference sequence search and suffix feasibility, plus all shared fixture/oracle/resource consumers for masked paths, separate catalogs, aborts, or guessed booleans.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The list is exhaustive for the five confirmed deferrals. Every resource case must reach its named evaluator path; a literal-suffix guard case may remain only when named separately from frontier/memo coverage.

entries.reachability: A bounded repeated group first captures a referenced descendant and may either stop at an intermediate count or continue through a nonparticipating sibling to its maximum.

entries.evidence: Recorder libc rejects ^((a)|b){0,2}\2$ on aa and accepts aba; current JavaScript accepts both and a live hide rule suppresses aa incorrectly.
entries.remaining: Separate sanitized endpoint projection from retained continuation state and pin aa false plus aba true through libc, focused, and live fresh cases.
